name: snoozer-backend
description: Omnia Snoozer backend for Shopify, Zoho, and OpenAI integrations

scripts.package:lambda: tar -a -cf snoozer-backend.zip index.js package.json package-lock.json data handlers routes services utils node_modules faqs.json knowledge_base.json
scripts.package:with-deps: rm -f build.zip && npm ci && zip -r build.zip . -x ".git/*" -x "*.log" -x "build.zip"
scripts.package:without-deps: rm -f build.zip && zip -r build.zip . -x "node_modules/*" -x ".git/*" -x "*.log" -x "build.zip" && echo "⚠️ Remember: use a Lambda Layer for node_modules if you ship this zip."
